videos.title: Explaining Why GTA is Great for Your Brain (while playing it)
videos.description:
For practical, science-based advice that might change your life, sign up for my newsletter here: http://bit.ly/3JRg3NX

Studies mentioned in this video can be referenced here: 
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QYDAQMu_vLudNaq8UGNNUqi5q6EIs0O4S3BNj2LAbSI/edit?usp=sharing

---

Video games aren’t rotting your brain. The research says they barely move your well-being at all, but that research gets thin for the people who play the most, which is exactly where the problems show up. So I played the first few hours of GTA 6 to find where the line is, and it comes down to one question: do you feel more capable after you play, or are you playing so you don’t have to feel incapable?
